findings.motion: Coauthor of HB 892, proof of citizenship to register to vote
findings.note: Listed as a coauthor of HB 892, a bill to require proof of citizenship to register to vote. The House sent it to the Elections Committee on 2025-03-06, where it stayed. The date the name was added is not shown on the page.

findings.motion: Coauthor of HB 2332, citizenship marking on ID and its use in election processes
findings.note: Listed as a coauthor of HB 2332, which deals with how a state ID or driver's license shows US citizenship and how that is used in election processes. Referred to the House Elections Committee on 2025-03-14. The date the name was added is not shown on the page.

findings.motion: Coauthor of HB 2245, verifying citizenship of registered voters
findings.note: Listed as a coauthor of HB 2245, a bill on verifying the citizenship status of registered voters. Referred to the House Elections Committee on 2025-03-14. The date the name was added is not shown on the page.

findings.motion: Coauthor of HB 2739, address on ID must match voter list
findings.note: Listed as a coauthor of HB 2739, a bill requiring the address on an ID shown by a voter to match the address on the voter list. It was left pending in House committee on 2025-04-17. The date the name was added is not shown on the page.
subjects: ID address must match voter list

findings.motion: Coauthor of HB 4474, appearance of ID issued to non-citizens
findings.note: Listed as a coauthor of HB 4474, which changes how an ID or driver's license issued to a non-citizen looks. Referred to a House committee on 2025-04-03. The date the name was added is not shown on the page.

findings.motion: Cosponsor of SB 16, proof of citizenship to register to vote
findings.note: Listed as a House cosponsor of SB 16, which requires proof of citizenship to register to vote and lets a voter without proof cast a limited federal ballot. The Senate passed it on 2025-04-01 and a House committee reported it on 2025-05-25. The date the name was added is not shown on the page.

findings.motion: Cosponsor of SJR 37, constitutional amendment that a voter must be a US citizen
findings.note: Listed as a House cosponsor of SJR 37, a proposed constitutional amendment clarifying that a voter must be a United States citizen. The date the name was added is not shown on the page.

findings.motion: Final House adoption of SJR 37, constitutional amendment that a voter must be a US citizen (Record 2196, 102 yeas, 14 nays, 22 present not voting)
findings.note: House Journal record vote on adopting SJR 37, a proposed constitutional amendment clarifying that a voter must be a United States citizen. The Journal lists this member as voting yea.
